summary: Buildings face emerging control challenges due to varying occupancy and environmental conditions. MPCPy addresses this issue by facilitating occupant-integrated model predictive control for building systems. The platform optimizes control input to predict building performance, benefiting building owners and occupants. Its flexible design accommodates different approaches to model predictive control, enabling researchers to develop best-practice methods. MPCPy's impact is most relevant in urban areas where energy efficiency and occupant comfort are crucial. The platform's focus on data-driven models and optimization techniques aligns with efforts to improve building energy efficiency and reduce environmental impact.
